This GET operation at /projects/columns/{column_id} returns metadata about the column including its name, position within the project board, creation and update timestamps, and other configuration details. items.docs: The PATCH operation on the /projects/columns/{column_id} endpoint allows developers to modify the properties of an existing project column within GitHub Projects. By sending a PATCH request with the column's unique identifier, users can update attributes such as the column's name. This endpoint is particularly useful for reorganizing project boards, renaming workflow stages, or adjusting column configurations without needing to delete and recreate columns. items.docs: The Delete Project Column operation removes a specific column from a GitHub project board by making a DELETE request to the /projects/columns/{column_id} endpoint. This API call permanently deletes the specified column identified by its unique column_id parameter, along with all the cards contained within that column.
